blockers.game_identity: Montana State at Montana State, 1915-02-20, literal score 12-9
blockers.detail: Current Montana State official edition records MSU W 12-9; older official edition records MSU L 12-9. The game identity is stable but Gonzaga result and score-side allocation are unresolved.

Older Montana State opponent-series history assigns the 32-7 game to Gonzaga in Bozeman; current Montana State year-by-year assigns the 32-7 game to Montana. It is not admitted to the Gonzaga identified-game ledger pending reconciliation.
Eight concrete reciprocal losses are identified, exceeding Gonzaga's official seven-loss season aggregate. No game is removed or reclassified by arithmetic.
Two concrete reciprocal wins are identified, exceeding Gonzaga's official one-win season aggregate. No game is removed or reclassified by arithmetic.

Current Gonzaga official series notes describe Gonzaga as winning the first meeting 21-18, while current Washington State official history records Washington State winning 21-18. This contradiction was discovered incidentally and is routed to the next bounded discrepancy family rather than resolved inside the Montana State family.

nonblocking_residuals.basis: Current Montana State and current Gonzaga official sources agree on 29-16; older Montana State guides say 29-17.
nonblocking_residuals.reopen_condition: Concrete primary evidence contradicting current reciprocal/target agreement.
